layers.text: Camera: seen from the front and slightly above, like a vegetable garden on a strategy game map; drawn on a fully transparent background; nothing is cropped at the top or the bottom.

Class: crops for a square farm tile of a strategy game map: big plump simple plants growing in straight horizontal rows, each row on its own long narrow strip of tilled brown soil; a dark brown outline (never black), no box, no border and no frame. Everything that is not a plant or its strip of soil is empty and transparent.

layers.text: Subject: a small wheat field: four straight horizontal strips of tilled soft tan-brown soil, one above the other, each running from the left edge to the right edge of the image, with clear empty transparent gaps between the strips; on each strip stands one row of four big plump round wheat sheaves side by side, pale straw gold with a soft darker straw shadow on the lower right. Crops and soil only.
